question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Casual
solution:
The correct answer is '**Formal**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Casual**' is '**Formal**'.
 
• **Casual**: relaxed and not worried; without showing great effort or interest. (तनावमुक्त और अचिंतित; प्रयास, परवाह या रुचि से वंचित)
 
 
• *Example: I’m not happy about your **casual** attitude to your work.*
 
 
 
• **Formal**: (used about language or behaviour) used when you want to appear serious or official and in situations in which you do not know the other people very well. [(भाषण या आचरण) औपचारिक, गंभीरतापूर्ण और ऐसी स्थिति में उपयुक्त जिसमें अन्‍य व्‍यक्ति आपके सुपरिचित न हों]
 
 
• *Example: ‘Yours faithfully’ is a **formal** way of ending a letter.***
 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__*** Formal.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Spiritual**: concerning deep thoughts, feelings or emotions rather than the body or physical things. [गहन विचारों, भावनाओं या मनोभावों से संबंधित (न कि शरीर या भौतिक वस्‍तुओं से) आत्मिक; आध्‍यात्मिक]
 
• **Personal**: of or belonging to one particular person. (व्‍यक्ति-विशेष का या उससे संबंधित; व्‍यक्तिगत, वैयक्तिक)
 
• **Traditional**: existing in or as part of a tradition; long-established. (परंपरागत, पारंपरिक)
